title: Design System: PAIS Orders and Education & Training

authority.otherPages: Incumbent components, global CSS, and .21st/design.json decisions remain authoritative. This sidecar grants no wider redesign authority.

shadows.name: record-section
shadows.purpose: Scoped sections use borders and tonal grouping.

limitations: No populated academic/training entries available for review

narrative.overview: Confirmed clean, professional navy-and-white direction for Orders and Education & Training only. Compact summaries, clear search, restrained borders, and readable operational records inherit the existing PAIS light and dark themes.
keyCharacteristics: Orders: seven summary cells, search first, collapsed general and advanced filters, scrolling table
Education & Training: five summary cells, native personnel details, academic and training columns stacking on mobile
Selection separate from disclosure; entry actions remain visible

rules.name: Bounded module scope
rules.body: Preserve the incumbent design authority for all other pages and the existing PAIS theme, permissions, data, and document workflows.

dos: Do use live PAIS aliases for light and dark themes
Do keep search prominent and record copy readable
donts: Don't widen the redesign to other modules
Don't claim populated-entry or mutation-flow verification from this review
